description: This source file provides platform-dependent utility functions for the BSP Template Object in the BroadWay Service Delivery System. It specifically contains factory functions to create various component objects related to the BSP Engine, such as access, list, output set, variable, branch, stack, template, runtime, writer, and archive components.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CreateBspEngComponent(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates a BSP Engine component object by invoking BspEngCOCreate with the provided context handles.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CreateBspEngReaderComponent(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates a BSP Engine reader component object using BspTemplateReaderCOCreate.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CreateBspEngAccessComponent(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates an access component for BSP Engine via BspTemplateAccessCOCreate.
